tot=np.sum((dA_dt-dA_dt.mean())**2)
forms={
 'sin': lambda p: p[3]*np.sin(p[4]*t)*A**p[5],
 'texp': lambda p: p[3]*t*np.exp(-p[4]*t)*A**p[5],
 'tpow': lambda p: p[3]*t**p[4]*A**p[5],
 'tpowsat': lambda p: p[3]*t**p[4]*A**p[5]/(1+p[6]*A**2),
 'cos': lambda p: p[3]*np.cos(p[4]*t)*A**p[5],
 'tAexp': lambda p: p[3]*t**p[4]*np.exp(-p[6]*A)*A**p[5],
}
for nm,f in forms.items():
    best=None
    for s in range(40):
        rng=np.random.default_rng(s)
        p0=np.array([-0.2,11,0.1,0.1,rng.uniform(0.2,2),rng.uniform(-1,2),rng.uniform(0.1,1)])
        p0[1]=11+rng.normal(0,1)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: p[0]*A**3+p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*t)+f(p)-dA_dt, p0)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception: pass
    print(nm, np.round(best.x,4), np.sum(best.fun**2)/tot)
